title: Well Intervention Strategies for Production Enhancement
metaDescription: Use case: an automated production enhancement system for a national oil company, validated in two giant brownfields, delivering 250,000 BOPD of incremental production with 17% less CAPEX.

context.heading: Context and drivers
items: The operator must optimize CAPEX through improved utilization of existing assets
Increase production from mature brownfields at profitable operating costs
Accelerate decision-making to maximize production across large asset bases
Achieving these goals requires a scalable, accurate and fast method for identifying high-value production enhancement opportunities while minimizing risk

items.heading: Slow candidate identification
items.body: Conventional workflows struggle to identify and rank production enhancement opportunities across thousands of wells quickly enough to support aggressive targets.

items.heading: Operational readiness
items.body: Workover and intervention teams need continuous, data-driven support to sustain high-frequency campaigns.

items.heading: Poor predictive accuracy
items.body: Traditional engineering models often fail to reliably predict post-job well productivity, resulting in lower success rates and inefficient resource allocation.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.intro: An Automated Production Enhancement System, deployed to transform the full lifecycle of workover and production optimization, from opportunity identification to post-job evaluation. Core capabilities:
capabilities: Automated ranking and selection of prime candidates with reduced risk
AI-driven predictions of post-job well performance, enabling investment decisions
Closed-loop analytics to evaluate job outcomes, strengthen future recommendations and continuously improve field performance

items.label: Validated in two giant brownfields with 3,000+ active well strings and 1,400+ workovers executed annually
>80% predictive accuracy in blind tests, better than traditional models
5–20× increase in feasible, high-value opportunities compared with manual reviews
17% reduction in CAPEX required to achieve the production uplift

impact.heading: Business impact
impact.intro: Supports the operator's strategic production growth targets by:
items: Accelerating delivery of sustainable production gains
